sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I'm at a café beside the bus shelter.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I've got ten minutes before my bus leaves.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Can I have a plain hot tea to go?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sure, would you like any lemon with that?

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: No, thanks, I'd like it plain, just hot tea.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Okay, that'll be two pounds.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks, I'll pay by card.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Here's your receipt, just wait by the counter.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The same worker hands me a cup of iced tea.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Excuse me, I think this is the iced lemon tea.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Oh, you're right, let me check your receipt.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: I ordered a plain hot tea to go.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: That's what the receipt says, sorry about that.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Can you take this back and make a hot tea?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Of course, I'll take it back and make yours now.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: I've got a bus to catch, how long will it take?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: I'll make you a fresh cup of hot tea, but it'll take three minutes.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Sorry, how many minutes did you say?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Three minutes.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Great, I've got time, so I'll wait here.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: And could you make it without lemon, please?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Of course, just plain hot tea.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I wait by the counter while the worker makes my tea.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Here you go, one plain hot tea to go.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Could you put a lid on the cup?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sure, I'll put a lid on it now.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks, it'll be easier to carry to the bus.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks, do I need to pay anything else?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: No, you've already paid for the hot tea.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Great, I'll take it with me to the bus stop.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: You're welcome, have a good trip.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I check the lid and pick up my hot tea.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I head to the shelter before my bus leaves.
